limitations: The HTTP route inventory is derived from generated Fastify operation registrations; independently registered Better Auth metadata and runtime module contributions are represented in separate contract or reverse-trace inventories.

Tool discovery covers literal server.tool names in the listed MCP module. Other registration modules, enabled-action expansion, and runtime-composed tools remain outside the current bounded scan and are reported as discovery limitations; dynamic names in this scope fail closed.

SQL discovery covers named top-level tables, functions, triggers, indexes, and ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT declarations in the listed initial migration. Other migrations, inline table constraints, and runtime-generated objects remain outside the current bounded scan and are reported as discovery limitations; unsupported DDL fails closed.
Candidate requirement links are navigation aids and do not establish implementation coverage or conformance.
